_comment: Use-case config 3. RMS voltage on CH1, automatic trigger. CH1 2 V/div (use 5 for 24 V calibrations). Plain numbers in the scope's native units: horizontal_scale in SECONDS (0.002 = 2 ms/div, 2.0 = 2 s/div), vertical_scale in V/div, vertical_position in divisions, trigger_position in %, record_length in points, trigger_level in volts (or "half_battery" = half of battery_voltage). sample_rate is derived from record_length + horizontal_scale when null.
